Tests that the content of resources with JSON MIME types can be accessed when loaded by asynchronous XHR requests (Bug 80684) or within iframes/documents.

Running test: test1

request.url: http://127.0.0.1:8000/inspector-protocol/network/resources/json.php?type=application%2Fjson
request.type: XHR
request.mimeType: application/json
request.base64Encoded: false
request.content: {"number": "42"}


request.url: http://127.0.0.1:8000/inspector-protocol/network/resources/json.php?type=application%2Fjson
request.type: Document
request.mimeType: application/json
request.base64Encoded: false
request.content: {"number": "42"}


Running test: test2

request.url: http://127.0.0.1:8000/inspector-protocol/network/resources/json.php?type=application%2Fvnd.document%2Bjson
request.type: XHR
request.mimeType: application/vnd.document+json
request.base64Encoded: false
request.content: {"number": "42"}


request.url: http://127.0.0.1:8000/inspector-protocol/network/resources/json.php?type=application%2Fvnd.document%2Bjson
request.type: Document
request.mimeType: application/vnd.document+json
request.base64Encoded: false
request.content: {"number": "42"}
